text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Still in Love 
came to an end, and she was forced to 
confront her own slump in earnest.

The hospitalization for examination lasted 
a long time. Perhaps stepping away from 
work and resting helped... My body 
gradually returned to how it used to be.

—In the end, the cause of the poor 
condition remained unknown.

"And during my hospitalization, I never 
heard a single word from Still in Love."
choice_data_list:
(No word from her at all... Did something 
happen...?)

(No word from her at all... I wonder if 
something happened...)

text_block_list.text:
Worried about her, I headed straight for 
the academy the moment I was discharged 
from the hospital. And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The final destination of this "orbit."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love is "LOS." She's... "gone" 
now.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Still in Love submitted her 
withdrawal notice a short while ago.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... As Tracen Academy, of course we 
intended to convince her to stay, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Vanished into thin air, just like a puff 
of smoke...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...So you didn't know about it either, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Your withdrawal form hasn't been accepted 
yet. I felt it necessary to hear your side 
of the story first."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Still, if they don't come back like this—

Still in Love had vanished. Devastated by 
that reality... I stepped out into the 
hallway in confusion—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "FLPT"... I gathered them.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe too... prays for Still in 
Love's "happiness".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Piece it together. The "heart" of Still in 
Love.

Inside the bag received from Neo Universe 
were the torn-up fragments of a letter.

Thinking there might be a hint to find 
her, I desperately pieced the clues 
together, and—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Dear Kind Soul,"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Please forgive me for sending you such a 
letter."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I was all alone... for so long.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am... exactly the kind of girl 
you know me to be."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Yet you... found me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I brought suffering upon you because of 
that. I do not believe an apology could 
ever earn your forgiveness.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"However, please believe this one thing. I 
have only ever wished for your happiness."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please take good care 
of yourself, always.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I will, forever—

—Clutching the letter tightly in my hand, 
I took off running. I couldn't just sit 
still. I had to find her as quickly as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Wah! Wh-what is it...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Still? Who... is that?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Was there someone like that...? Hmm...
choice_data_list: Look, the second Triple Tiara winner!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“...Who was that again? Hmm, I can't seem 
to recall...”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, more importantly! The girls debuting 
on the Tiara route next seem super hyped—

Everything went dark before my eyes. She 
was indeed an inconspicuous girl. But 
there's no way she could ever be 
forgotten...!
choice_data_list:
(Could she really be disappearing from 
this world—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still in Love-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Alv-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The second Triple Tiara Umamusume is Still 
in Love.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...How can everyone just forget about her?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I know. But I don't know where she is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Why don't you go find it for them 
quickly?
choice_data_list: ...Still, what if it's no longer anywhere—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm right here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...She is. That person is definitely out 
there somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: And—I am waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Please tell her this: If you don't 
hurry up, you won't ever catch up to me."

Admire Groove is right. If I give up 
now... I'll surely never see her again.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, mister.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, miss.

Right then, the one who called out to me 
was... a young Umamusume girl holding a 
Still in Love plushie.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Where is Still-chan?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
My friends say they aren't real. That it's 
just me.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I want to see you...

Gently stroking the child's head, I make a 
firm resolve. There is no way I can let 
her simply fade away like this.

More than anything... I want to see Still 
in Love once again.
choice_data_list: I will... find it, no matter what

text_block_list.text:
How much time had passed since then? Ever 
since I decided to see her, my sense of 
time gradually blurred—and I couldn't 
sleep again.

...I already knew. The closer I tried to 
get to her, the more I would lose my form 
as a human being.
choice_data_list:
Even so, it doesn't matter. I have to go 
get her...

text_block_list.text:
Day after day. Day after day after day 
after day after day, day after day after 
day, I kept walking.
And—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?!
choice_data_list: Sorry, it took a bit longer this time...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...! I... I can't do that...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... You won't get away 
unscathed.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
You must have felt it, didn't you? A 
further transformation...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The blood that had slowly intertwined... 
grew faint with separation.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If you pour it in there once more— unable 
to withstand such far thicker blood, the 
vessel will...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Shattering to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm no longer... the person I used to be.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I cannot return. Not anymore... to that 
side...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're... Why...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Why go... that far...?
choice_data_list:
I told you, didn't I? That I'd protect 
you.

I told you, didn't I? That I'd protect 
you.

text_block_list.text:
—If anything happens, this time I will 
protect you no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Just... for that reason alone...?
choice_data_list: Besides, I... just wanted to see you.
Besides, I... just wanted to see you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

I reach out a hand to Still in Love. I 
won't leave her alone ever again. Even 
now...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...No fair.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Not fair... it's not fair...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... wanted to protect you too...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I wanted you... to be happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The truth is... All this time...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you... all this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: To meet... with you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: To be by your side...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Me too. My feelings... have never 
changed either.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even now—I love you.
